objective: Execute one combined controller-authored correction pass from the verified Phase 21 artifact that (1) redesigns the bottle into a modern current-day 500 mL PET soda bottle and (2) replaces the low-resolution 256x67 label proxy with the crisp 1536x399 Zestly label texture, then return visual and geometric evidence without local redesign.
instructions: Load Rhino CHATGPT orientation in operator mode and safely synchronize clean main with origin/main.
Prepare bridge-phase24-001 using the normal exchange lifecycle.
Do not execute bridge-phase23-001. It is superseded by this combined pass.
Do not use bridge-phase22-001 as a source model. Phase 22 was rejected for visual regression.
Use only the verified Phase 21 artifact .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase21-001/ZESTLY_BOTTLE_PASS1.3dm as the source state. Open it as a dedicated document if necessary.

Before mutation, confirm the Phase 21 source has modeling_run_id=zestly-modern-soda-bottle-001 and exactly 34 live foundation objects: bottle body, neck finish, printed label sleeve, screw cap, tamper ring, base contact ring, and 28 cap ribs.

Verify the high-resolution label asset exists at .bridge/assets/bridge-phase24-001/zestly_full_label_1536.jpg, is 1536x399 pixels, and has SHA-256 6ec396c93db291d15b2420c3f26db7dbd80a46c57cc805a505a8f82ffe38b69c.
Run python3 .bridge/run_rhino_payload.py --task bridge-phase24-001 --dry-run and require success.
Execute the exact controller payload against the verified Phase 21 document. Do not edit, repair, substitute, or rewrite rhino.py or manifest.json.
If any controller API call or geometry construction fails, stop and report the exact blocker. Do not locally redesign or simplify the model.

After execution, inspect the new bottle as a visual product model, not just as a topology exercise. The intended design language is a contemporary commercial PET soda bottle: smooth fast shoulder transition, believable 500 mL proportions, cylindrical label zone, pronounced lower grip waist, modern dimple detailing, and a five-foot petaloid-style base with a raised center rather than the rejected Phase 22 bulbous sphere.

Confirm the new bottle does not contain any detached bulb or geometry below the intended petaloid feet. The intended standing/contact plane is approximately Z=0 and the bottle body central underside begins at Z=6mm.
Validate the main body, neck, support ring, cap, tamper ring, five petaloid feet, grip details, and cap ribs. Report invalid/nonmanifold/open solids objectively.

Run assembly intersection checks, but distinguish deliberate visual integration contacts (petaloid feet into lower body, grip-detail rings touching the body, cap ribs touching cap body) from accidental detached/interpenetrating geometry. Do not redesign locally.

Capture high-quality rendered Front, Right, Top, Bottom, and Isometric views. Also capture at least one close-up rendered Front view focused on the label at sufficient viewport resolution to judge text/logo sharpness.

In the evidence, explicitly compare label sharpness against Phase 21: Phase 21 used 256x67; this pass must use 1536x399. Report whether the front label appears visibly sharper in the rendered close-up.

Explicitly report which label region is centered in the standard Front render. Desired: green Zestly hero panel centered/front-facing. The mapping rotation is controller-authored; do not rotate it yourself.
Measure overall height, max body diameter, waist diameter, label diameter/height, cap diameter, and body/base minimum Z. Compare them to the controller nominal values from the payload.

Verify all new controlled objects carry task_id=bridge-phase24-001, modeling_run_id=zestly-modern-soda-bottle-001, pass_index=2, pass_kind=correction, revision=2, parent=bridge-phase21-001, parent_task_id, and parent_result_commit.
Save the combined result as .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase24-001/ZESTLY_MODERN_BOTTLE_HIRES_PASS2.3dm. Do not overwrite earlier artifacts.

Write the canonical .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase24-001/pass-evaluation.json. Set local_modeling_used=false, local_modeling_authorized=false, payload_modified_by_operator=false, provenance_check=pass, and operator_recommendation_scope=evidence_only.

The pass-evaluation must include the high-resolution texture path/hash/dimensions, exact object summary, validation summary, intended-contact intersections, measurements, all capture paths, saved artifact verification, retries/errors, and objective discrepancies.
Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase24-001/operator-experience.md with execution observations only. No redesign proposals.
Run git diff --check and verify only Phase 24 evidence/artifacts/report files were added on the operator branch.
Commit evidence/artifacts as the work commit and capture RESULT_COMMIT.

Create .bridge/reports/bridge-phase24-001.json with ack exactly BRIDGE-PHASE24-ZESTLY-MODERN-HIRES-20260924-74C2A9-OPERATOR-ACK, exact base_commit, RESULT_COMMIT, and branch operator/bridge-phase24-001.
Run python3 .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report bridge-phase24-001 and require REPORT_OK.
Commit the report separately, push operator/bridge-phase24-001, and do not merge it.
